parties: Composure Services Pvt Ltd and Saregama India Limited
headline: Composure Services Pvt Ltd files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure of substantial acquisition in Saregama India Limited
sum: Composure Services Pvt Ltd has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4) regarding substantial acquisition of shares in Saregama India Limited. The filing, submitted to NSE, indicates a significant change in shareholding that triggers SEBI's disclosure norms for substantial acquisitions and takeovers.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures precede formal open offer announcements and signal crossing of the 5% threshold or further substantial acquisition; counsel should confirm the exact acquisition percentage and tranche history to model open offer mechanics, exemption eligibility, and timing under SEBI(SAST)R 2011.
detail: Composure Services Pvt Ltd has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the National Stock Exchange. This disclosure is a mandatory filing triggered by acquisition of shares that meet or exceed the substantial shareholding threshold. The specific quantum of shares acquired, purchase consideration, and timing details are contained in the full regulatory submission filed with NSE.
